param.check.migrate-schedule.summary.text: trägt auf der Werkbank das Format ein, ab dem eine Karte Termine trägt, von jeder Nummer ab 7 aus, damit ein älteres Dinah den Speicher abweist, statt eine Karte mit Termin zu früh auszugeben; eine Werkbank unter Format 7 wird abgewiesen und führt zuerst --migrate-designations aus; ohne --yes wird nichts geschrieben
param.check.migrate-schedule.summary.context: The written meaning of the --migrate-schedule flag of check. It writes the one format line on the workbench anchor and reads no card, and without the confirmation flag it writes nothing at all.

next.waiting.context: Printed beside a column that offers no card because none of the ready cards standing there that the caller could otherwise take may be taken yet, and at least one of them waits on another card to start or finish. Others may wait on a date. {cards} is one to three references of the cards waited on, joined by a comma and a space, which are not translated.

next.waiting.more.context: As next.waiting, where more than three cards are waited on. {cards} is the first three references; {n} is how many further cards are waited on, always 1 or more.

answer.pull.waiting.bare.text: Dinah hat bereite Arbeit zum Ziehen gefunden, aber nichts davon darf schon genommen werden, und ein Teil davon wartet auf andere Karten: {cards}
answer.pull.waiting.bare.context: The sentence pull prints when the bare form was asked, a column holds ready work, none of it the caller could otherwise take may be taken yet, and at least one card of it waits on another card to start or finish. Others may wait on a date. {cards} is one to three card references joined by a comma and a space, untranslated.

answer.pull.waiting.bare.more.text: Dinah hat bereite Arbeit zum Ziehen gefunden, aber nichts davon darf schon genommen werden, und ein Teil davon wartet auf andere Karten: {cards} und {n} weitere
answer.pull.waiting.bare.more.context: As answer.pull.waiting.bare, where more than three cards are waited on. {n} is how many further cards are waited on, always 1 or more.

answer.pull.waiting.named.text: Dinah hat in {upstream} bereite Arbeit für {destination} gefunden, aber nichts davon darf schon genommen werden, und ein Teil davon wartet auf andere Karten: {cards}
answer.pull.waiting.named.context: As answer.pull.waiting.bare, for the named form. {upstream} and {destination} are column titles.

answer.pull.waiting.named.more.text: Dinah hat in {upstream} bereite Arbeit für {destination} gefunden, aber nichts davon darf schon genommen werden, und ein Teil davon wartet auf andere Karten: {cards} und {n} weitere
answer.pull.waiting.named.more.context: As answer.pull.waiting.named, where more than three cards are waited on. {n} is how many further cards are waited on, always 1 or more.

warn.waiting-on.text: diese Karte wartete auf {detail}; Sie haben sie benannt, also hat nichts sie zurückgehalten, und sie wartet nur dann wieder, wenn ihr Anspruch freigegeben wird oder abläuft, bevor sie die Verpflichtungsspalte erreicht
warn.waiting-on.context: A warning on a successful claim of a card a link was holding back until another card started or finished. The claim starts the card for as long as it is held; a card whose claim is released, or runs out, short of the workbench's commitment column has not started and is held again. {detail} is one or more card references joined by a comma and a space, untranslated.

warn.hold-cycle.text: diese Verknüpfung schließt einen Kreis von Karten, die jeweils auf die nächste warten, also werden next und pull keine von ihnen ausgeben: {detail}
warn.hold-cycle.context: A warning on a successful link whose kind the workbench declares under dinah.holds. {detail} is the cycle's card references, joined by a comma and a space, untranslated.

card.waits-on.start.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds that holds this card back until another card starts. {card} is that card's reference and is never translated. Waits is the word rather than held, because held by names whoever holds a claim.

card.waits-on.finish.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds that holds this card back until another card reaches a done column. {card} is that card's reference and is never translated.

card.waits-on.reach.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds that holds this card back until another card reaches a named column or any column after it. {card} is that card's reference and is never translated; {column} is the column's title.

card.waits-on.not-before.context: One of the card.waits-on lines, already rendered as {line}, followed by the earliest day the wait could end given the other card's own dates. {date} is a date written YYYY-MM-DD and is never translated.

card.waits-until.start.one.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tag nach dem Beginn von {card}
card.waits-until.start.one.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds whose other card has started, where the link also asks for a number of days after that; the form for one day. {date} is the day, written YYYY-MM-DD, on which time alone releases this card; {card} is the other card's reference. Neither is translated.

card.waits-until.start.other.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tage nach dem Beginn von {card}
card.waits-until.start.other.context: As card.waits-until.start.one, the form for any other number of days.

card.waits-until.finish.one.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tag nach dem Abschluss von {card}
card.waits-until.finish.one.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds whose other card has reached a done column, where the link also asks for a number of days after that; the form for one day. {date} is the day, written YYYY-MM-DD, on which time alone releases this card; {card} is the other card's reference. Neither is translated.

card.waits-until.finish.other.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tage nach dem Abschluss von {card}
card.waits-until.finish.other.context: As card.waits-until.finish.one, the form for any other number of days.

card.waits-until.reach.one.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tag, nachdem {card} {column} erreicht hat
card.waits-until.reach.one.context: Printed under the card line for a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds whose other card has reached a named column, where the link also asks for a number of days after that; the form for one day. {date} is the day, written YYYY-MM-DD, on which time alone releases this card; {card} is the other card's reference and {column} the column's title.

card.waits-until.reach.other.text: wartet bis {date}: {n} Tage, nachdem {card} {column} erreicht hat
card.waits-until.reach.other.context: As card.waits-until.reach.one, the form for any other number of days.

schedule.cell.waiting.context: A cell of the Schedule column in a card listing. A link the workbench declares under dinah.holds holds the card back today, so next and pull pass it over. {cards} is the references of the cards it waits on, joined by a comma and a space, and is never translated.

schedule.cell.and-waiting.context: A cell of the Schedule column in a card listing. {cell} is another schedule cell, already rendered, and the card also waits on the cards named in {cards}, joined by a comma and a space, which are never translated.

check.holds-malformed.text: der dinah.holds-Block in dieser workbench.md kann so nicht verwendet werden, also gilt für das fehlerhafte Element vorerst sein Standardwert, eine Art, deren held nicht named oder carrier ist, hält nichts zurück, und ein start_at, das keine Spalte außer der ersten des Ablaufs oder einer Erledigt-Spalte nennt, weicht der Standard-Verpflichtungsspalte: {detail}
check.holds-malformed.context: A check finding, followed by the workbench.md path in parentheses. {detail} carries `dinah.holds not a mapping`; or `dinah.holds`, the member and the text read, as `dinah.holds start_at nowhere`; or `dinah.holds`, a link kind and `not a mapping`; or `dinah.holds`, a link kind, the member and the text read. held takes named or carrier, waits_for takes start or finish, lag_days a whole number from 0 to 365, and start_at and finish_at a column. dinah.holds, the member names and the words they take are never translated.

check.holds-member-unknown.text: der dinah.holds-Block in dieser workbench.md trägt ein Element, das dieser Build nicht liest, und es wird ignoriert: {detail}
check.holds-member-unknown.context: A check finding at cleanup severity, followed by the workbench.md path in parentheses. {detail} is the member's name, preceded by the link kind where the member belongs to one. The block's members are start_at and kinds, and a kind's are held, waits_for, lag_days and finish_at, so the finding is most often a misspelling of one of them.

check.hold-cycle.text: diese Karten warten jeweils über eine Verknüpfung, die dinah.holds erklärt, auf die nächste, also geben next und pull keine von ihnen aus, bis eine von ihnen beginnt: {detail}
check.hold-cycle.context: A check finding, followed by the path of the lowest-numbered card's card.md in parentheses. {detail} is the cycle's card references in the order each waits on the next, joined by a comma and a space, and is never translated. Moving any of the cards to the workbench's commitment column, claiming one, or removing a link breaks the cycle.

check.holds-below-format.text: diese Werkbank erklärt unter dinah.holds Verknüpfungen, die Karten zurückhalten, aber sie erklärt Format {detail}, also würde ein älteres Dinah eine zurückgehaltene Karte zu früh ausgeben; führen Sie `dinah check --migrate-holds --yes` aus, damit ein älteres Dinah sie stattdessen abweist
check.holds-below-format.context: A check finding: a workbench declaring a storage format below the one that introduced holds carried by links, where its dinah.holds block declares at least one usable rule. {detail} carries the declared format number. dinah.holds is file syntax and the command line inside the sentence is the repair; neither is translated.

param.check.migrate-holds.summary.text: trägt auf der Werkbank das Format ein, ab dem eine unter dinah.holds erklärte Verknüpfung eine Karte zurückhält, von jeder Nummer ab 7 aus, damit ein älteres Dinah den Speicher abweist, statt eine zurückgehaltene Karte zu früh auszugeben; eine Werkbank unter Format 7 wird abgewiesen und führt zuerst --migrate-designations aus; ohne --yes wird nichts geschrieben
param.check.migrate-holds.summary.context: The written meaning of the --migrate-holds flag of check. It writes the one format line on the workbench anchor and reads no card, and without the confirmation flag it writes nothing at all.

view.urgency.explain.blocks-others.count.context: The phrase --explain prints for the blocks-others term when one card waits on this card through a link the workbench declares under dinah.holds; the form for one card.
As view.urgency.explain.blocks-others.counted.one, the form for any other number of cards, including none.

cmd.tui.summary.text: Eine Ansicht über die Tastatur bearbeiten
cmd.tui.summary.context: The one-line summary of the tui command in dinah help. The command starts an interactive screen over one view, where a person moves between cards and acts on them with keys.

param.tui.view.summary.text: die Ansicht, in der Sie arbeiten, nach Namen; das Board, wenn Sie sie weglassen
param.tui.view.summary.context: The meaning of the one positional argument of `dinah tui`, printed in that command's arguments table. A view is a named drawing of the workbench, and board is the name of the view drawn as columns.

param.tui.plain.summary.text: zeichnet mit einfachen ASCII-Zeichen statt mit Unicode-Zeichen
param.tui.plain.summary.context: The meaning of the --plain flag of `dinah tui`, printed in that command's arguments table. ASCII and Unicode are the names of the two character sets and stay as they are.

check.tui.1.text: es wurde kein maschinenlesbares Format verlangt
check.tui.1.context: A row of the checks table `dinah help tui` prints: the condition the command checks first, that --json or another machine format was not given, because the command draws on a screen rather than answering a script.

check.tui.2.text: die Ansicht ist eine, die Sie sehen können
check.tui.2.context: A row of the checks table `dinah help tui` prints: the view named, or the board when none is, is declared by the user, the workbench or Dinah itself.

check.tui.3.text: Standardeingabe und Standardausgabe sind ein Terminal, das groß genug zum Zeichnen ist
check.tui.3.context: A row of the checks table `dinah help tui` prints: both standard streams are an interactive terminal, and its window is at least the smallest size the screen is drawn in.

refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.text: die Ansicht {detail} kann hier nicht über die Tastatur bearbeitet werden ({reason})
refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.tui-unavailable, which `dinah tui` carries when the terminal cannot carry the interactive screen, before anything is drawn. {detail} is the view's name and {reason} is a machine token naming why, one of not-a-terminal, no-size, too-small, dumb-terminal and no-key-description, which is never translated. The fragments refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.size, refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.capability and a next step are spliced on after it.

refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.size.text: ; das Fenster ist {size}, und dinah tui braucht mindestens {minimum}
refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.size.context: Spliced after refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable when the window is too small for the interactive screen. {size} is the window's width and height written as 50x10, and {minimum} is the smallest size the screen is drawn in, written the same way. dinah tui is the command and stays as it is.

refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.capability.context: Spliced after refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable when the terminal's terminfo description lacks a key the screen reads. {capability} is the capability's terminfo name, such as kcuu1, which is never translated.

refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.next-small.text: ; vergrößern Sie das Fenster, oder zeichnen Sie die Ansicht einmal mit dinah view
refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.next-small.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable when the window was too small. dinah view is the command that draws a view once and stays as it is.

refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.next.text: ; zeichnen Sie die Ansicht einmal mit dinah view
refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable.next.context: The next step of refusal.dinah.tui-unavailable for every reason other than a window that is too small. dinah view is the command that draws a view once and stays as it is.

interactive.heading.context: The left part of the first row of dinah tui's screen. {workbench} is the workbench's title and {view} is the view's title. The mark between them may be spaced however the language wants.

interactive.heading.filtered.context: The left part of the first row of dinah tui's screen while a filter is set. {workbench} is the workbench's title, {view} is the view's title and {query} is the filter the person typed.

interactive.heading.acting.context: The right part of the first row of dinah tui's screen, naming who acts and which model they declared. {actor} is the owner's name and {model} is the provider and model, such as anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, which are never translated.

interactive.heading.acting.operator.context: interactive.heading.acting for the workbench's operator, saying so. {actor} is the owner's name and {model} is the provider and model, which are never translated.

interactive.heading.no-actor.context: The right part of the first row of dinah tui's screen when no owner could be resolved, so the screen can be read but no act can be taken.

interactive.lane.section.context: The title of one lane in the lane bar of dinah tui, on a view with several sections. {section} is the section's title and {column} is the column's title.

interactive.too-small.context: The only row dinah tui draws while its window is smaller than it needs. {size} is the smallest size written as 60x12.

interactive.acted.claim.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row after a claim succeeded. {ref} is the card's reference, such as dinah-12.

interactive.acted.release.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row after a release succeeded. {ref} is the card's reference.

interactive.acted.move.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row after a move succeeded. {ref} is the card's reference and {column} is the destination column's title.

interactive.acted.comment.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row after a comment was posted. {ref} is the card's reference.

interactive.jump.nothing.text: nichts namens {text} ist hier eine Ansicht, eine Karte oder eine Spalte
interactive.jump.nothing.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row when the text typed after : names no view, card or column. {text} is what the person typed.

interactive.jump.no-lane.text: keine Karte dieser Ansicht steht in der Spalte {column}
interactive.jump.no-lane.context: Shown in dinah tui's message row when the column typed after : holds none of the view's cards. {column} is the column's title.

interactive.prompt.comment.context: The label above the text a person types to comment on a card in dinah tui. {ref} is the card's reference.

interactive.menu.title.context: The title of dinah tui's move menu, above the list of columns the card may be moved to. {ref} is the card's reference.

interactive.menu.row.context: One row of dinah tui's move menu. {number} is the digit that chooses it and {title} is the column's title.

interactive.menu.row.route.context: The row of dinah tui's move menu that is the next column on the card's route. {number} is the digit that chooses it and {title} is the column's title.

interactive.menu.row.reject.context: The row of dinah tui's move menu that sends the card back to the column its column rejects to. {number} is the digit that chooses it and {title} is the column's title.

interactive.crashed.text: die interaktive Ansicht wurde wegen eines internen Fehlers beendet, und das Terminal ist wiederhergestellt; der Fehler folgt
interactive.crashed.context: Written to standard error when dinah tui stopped because of a fault in Dinah itself, after the terminal has been given back. The error's own text and where it happened follow on the next lines.

interactive.help.show.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the Enter key does, which opens the selected card. Keep it short.

interactive.help.back.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what Enter and Backspace do while a card is open, which returns to the lanes. Keep it short.

interactive.help.claim.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the t key does, which takes up the selected card. Keep it short.

interactive.help.accept.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the a key does when it moves the card into a done column. {arrow} is an arrow mark and {column} is the destination column's title. Keep it short.

interactive.help.advance.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the a key does when it moves the card on along its route. {arrow} is an arrow mark and {column} is the destination column's title. Keep it short.

interactive.help.send-back.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the b key does, which sends the card back to the column its column rejects to. {arrow} is an arrow mark and {column} is the destination column's title. Keep it short.

interactive.help.move.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the m key does, which opens the menu of columns the card may be moved to. Keep it short.

interactive.help.release.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the r key does, which gives the card back. Keep it short.

interactive.help.comment.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the c key does, which opens a prompt for a comment on the card. Keep it short.

interactive.help.filter.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the / key does, which narrows the cards shown with a query. Keep it short.

interactive.help.jump.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the : key does, which goes to a view, a card or a column by name. Keep it short.

interactive.help.keys.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the ? key does, which shows every key. Keep it short.

interactive.help.fewer.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the ? key does while every key is shown, which goes back to the short list. Keep it short.

interactive.help.quit.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the q key and Ctrl+C do, which end the screen. Keep it short.

interactive.help.cancel.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what a key does that closes a menu or a prompt and does nothing else. Keep it short.

interactive.help.choose.context: A footer label of dinah tui's move menu: what Enter and the digit keys do, which move the card to a row. Keep it short.

interactive.help.post.context: A footer label of dinah tui's comment prompt: what Ctrl+D does, which records the comment. Keep it short.

interactive.help.newline.context: A footer label of dinah tui's comment prompt: what Enter does there, which starts a new line of the comment. Keep it short.

interactive.help.go.context: A footer label of dinah tui's jump and filter prompts: what Enter does there, which carries out what was typed. Keep it short.

interactive.help.up.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the up arrow and k do, which select the card above. Keep it short.

interactive.help.down.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the down arrow and j do, which select the card below. Keep it short.

interactive.help.left.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the left arrow and h do, which move to the lane to the left. Keep it short.

interactive.help.right.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what the right arrow and l do, which move to the lane to the right. Keep it short.

interactive.help.page.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what Page Up and Page Down do, which move a screenful at a time. Keep it short.

interactive.help.ends.context: A footer label of dinah tui: what Home and End do, which go to the first or the last row. Keep it short.

interactive.help.scroll.context: A footer label of dinah tui while a card is open: what the arrows do there, which scroll the card's text. Keep it short.

interactive.help.highlight.context: A footer label of dinah tui's move menu: what the up and down arrows do there, which move the highlight between rows. Keep it short.

interactive.key.enter.context: The label of the Enter key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.backspace.context: The label of the Backspace key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.ctrl-c.context: The label of the key combination Ctrl+C as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.ctrl-d.context: The label of the key combination Ctrl+D as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.ctrl-g.context: The label of the key combination Ctrl+G as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.up.context: The label of the up arrow key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.down.context: The label of the down arrow key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.left.context: The label of the left arrow key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.right.context: The label of the right arrow key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.pgup.context: The label of the Page Up key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.pgdown.context: The label of the Page Down key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.home.context: The label of the Home key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.

interactive.key.end.context: The label of the End key as the footer of dinah tui shows it. Write it the way keyboards in the language label that key, and keep it short.
